description: Department of Forest Conservation - Order release the block of Forest Land Gurugodakanda from 1st day of November - 2023
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the release of a specific block of forest land (2.0235 ha) from Reserved Forest status. It includes detailed land descriptions, boundaries, lot numbers, and survey information. While it mentions a government minister (Pavithra Wanniarachchi) and her ministerial title, the core content focuses on land/property matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette under Type 4.
